character_sheet: The Alien Boss is the leader of the WTF-Alien dungeon, a port addition promoted from the Alien (AlienBoss.java:22-39: 1.7.10 registered only the Alien) on the same rig: a torso and stomach on a neck carrying a three-piece head with four fangs and a two-piece lower jaw, a fifteen-blade crest fan, two-segment arms with three claw fingers each, legs of a thigh, a two-piece shin and a foot, and a five-segment spiked tail (ModelAlien.createBodyLayer, ModelAlien.java:136-360), drawn by the Alien's renderer at the Alien's scale (OreSpawnClient.java:53). It has 320 HP, 24 attack, 12 armour, 0.6 knockback resistance; its createAttributes speed of 0.55 (:60-68) is overridden to the Alien's 0.65 by the shared constructor (Alien.java:73), inherits the Alien's goals — village walking, torch breaking, wandering (Alien.java:82-101) — and adds a player hunt (AlienBoss.java:57). Its eighth-tick scan, its four-block attacking flag and its ~40 percent swing are the Alien's (Alien.java:221-246); a hit poisons one time in five (Alien.java:170-194) and withers one time in three for 60 ticks (AlienBoss.java:76-83). Every 200 ticks while its target lives it summons an Alien beside itself, up to three nearby (:86-117); it is immune to its own minions (:126-132) and never despawns (:135-138). It has no natural spawn: the dungeon places it. Read it as the Alien made heavier: the same stalking stride, a wider threat display, and the summon.
size_notes: Drawn at x1.1 of the rig by the Alien's renderer (AlienRenderer.java:25, applied :34-37; OreSpawnClient.java:53 registers AlienRenderer for alien_boss) on the 256x128 sheet (ModelAlien.java:360); 1.4 x 3.5 block hitbox (ModEntities.java:30-31) — the root box is larger than the Alien's but the drawn rig is not (design section 6: do not enlarge the bone boxes for that). The arms, claws, tail and legs are chains the code positions segment by segment (an FK chain in code, design section 5: real parent-child bones in the converted rig) — key the joints, never the positions.

groups.name: gait
groups.amplitude: pi x 0.5 = 1.571 rad (90 deg) x the walking speed, no threshold: the foot by the wave, the lower shin about −0.4, the upper shin and thigh about −0.8; the right leg the negative
groups.plain: the two legs stride with the walking speed, every piece of a leg swinging together about its own rest, the right leg opposite the left
groups.math: a = cos(t * 4.0 * 0.22) * pi * 0.5 * amount; lFoot.xRot = a, lShin.xRot = a - 0.4, lShin1.xRot = lThigh.xRot = a - 0.8; rFoot.xRot = -a, rShin.xRot = -a - 0.4, rShin1.xRot = rThigh.xRot = -a - 0.8
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 4.0 x wingspeed 0.22 = 0.88 rad/tick: the natural period is 2 pi / 0.88 = 7.14 ticks

groups.name: fan
groups.amplitude: attacking: pi x 0.1 = 0.314 rad (18 deg) about zero, blade k a k x 30-degree phase behind the centre, spread ±0.261 k about z; not attacking: every blade flat at −1.85 rad and unspread, still
groups.plain: the crest fan lies flat until the attacking flag is set, then spreads into a fan and ripples blade by blade
groups.math: attacking ? (fan.xRot = cos(t * 1.22 * 0.22) * pi * 0.1; fanlK.xRot = fanrK.xRot = cos(t * 1.22 * 0.22 - K * pi/6) * pi * 0.1; fanlK.zRot = 0.261 K, fanrK.zRot = -0.261 K) : (every blade xRot = -1.85, zRot = 0)
groups.phase: the synced DATA_ATTACKING byte (Alien.java:48, set at :230 within four blocks of a target, cleared at :239) selects the branch
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 1.22 x wingspeed 0.22 = 0.268 rad/tick: the natural period is 2 pi / 0.268 = 23.4 ticks

groups.name: tail
groups.amplitude: when the latch picks the tail: pi x 0.5 = 1.571 rad (90 deg) at 0.77 rad/tick, scaled 0.25 / 0.5 / 0.8 / 1.25 / 1.5 along segments 1-5 (each segment placed at the end of the one before; the spikes ride their segments, 4 and 5 splayed ±0.52); otherwise pi x 0.05 = 0.157 rad (9 deg) at 0.22 rad/tick with the same scaling
groups.plain: the tail lashes hard in the periods a per-entity random latch picks for it and sways gently otherwise, the tip swinging six times the base
groups.math: a = ri2 == 1 ? cos(t * 3.5 * 0.22) * pi * 0.5 : cos(t * 0.22) * pi * 0.05; tail1.yRot = spike1.yRot = 0.25a; tail2.yRot = 0.5a; tail3.yRot = 0.8a; tail4.yRot = 1.25a; tail5.yRot = 1.5a; spike4.yRot = tail4.yRot + 0.52, spike5.yRot = tail4.yRot - 0.52; positions along the chain by cos/sin x 10
groups.phase: a per-entity random latch (RenderInfo ri2, re-rolled at each rising zero-crossing of the 0.77 wave: :470-480) — at rest 1 in 15 periods, attacking 1 in 2
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 3.5 x wingspeed 0.22 = 0.77 rad/tick (period 8.16 ticks) when picked; ageInTicks x 0.22 (period 28.6 ticks) otherwise

groups.name: jaw
groups.amplitude: when the latch picks the jaw: |pi x 0.35| = up to 1.1 rad (63 deg) at 0.77 rad/tick, rectified (the jaw opens from the rest and never past it); otherwise |pi x 0.02| = up to 0.063 rad (3.6 deg) at 0.22 rad/tick
groups.plain: the lower jaw chomps wide in the periods the latch picks for it and works faintly otherwise; the wave is rectified, so it opens twice per period
groups.phase: a per-entity random latch (RenderInfo ri3) — at rest 1 in 15 periods, attacking always (ri3 = 1 at :478)
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 3.5 x wingspeed 0.22 = 0.77 rad/tick (period 8.16 ticks, visible 4.08) when picked; ageInTicks x 0.22 (period 28.6, visible 14.3) otherwise

groups.name: claws
groups.amplitude: when the latch picks an arm: |pi x 0.2| = up to 0.628 rad (36 deg) at 0.77 rad/tick, rectified — the upper arm swings twice it from −0.52 (right: −2.61), the forearm once it from 0.855 (right: 2.27), the three fingers four times it from 2.7 / 2.27 / 2.7 (right: 0.436 / 0.87 / 0.436), each placed at the end of the segment before; otherwise |pi x 0.03| = up to 0.094 rad (5.4 deg) at 0.22 rad/tick
groups.plain: each arm swings out and its claws curl in the periods the latch picks for it, and twitches faintly otherwise; rectified, so it reaches twice per period
groups.math: a = cos(t * 3.5 * 0.22) * pi * 0.2; s = cos(t * 0.22) * pi * 0.03; doLeftClaw(ri1 in {1,3} ? a : s): arml1.yRot = -0.52 + |2x|, arml2.yRot = 0.855 + |x|, clawl1/2/3.yRot = 2.7 / 2.27 / 2.7 + |4x|; doRightClaw(ri1 in {2,3} ? -a : s): armr1.yRot = -2.61 - |2x|, armr2.yRot = 2.27 - |x|, clawr1/2/3.yRot = 0.436 / 0.87 / 0.436 - |4x|; positions along the chain by sin/cos x 9 and 14
groups.phase: a per-entity random latch (RenderInfo ri1) — at rest each arm in 2 periods of 15, attacking 2 of 4
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 3.5 x wingspeed 0.22 = 0.77 rad/tick (period 8.16 ticks, visible 4.08) when picked; ageInTicks x 0.22 otherwise

behaviour: The legs stride on one speed-scaled wave at 0.88 rad/tick (a 7.1-tick period) and a full 90 degrees at top speed: the foot, the two shin pieces and the thigh of a leg swing together about their own rests, the right leg opposite the left (ModelAlien.java:367-369, :568-580). The torso and stomach are static.

The fifteen-blade crest fan lies flat and still until the synced DATA_ATTACKING byte is set (Alien.java:48, raised at :230 within four blocks of a target — the boss inherits the scan, AlienBoss.java:86-87); then it spreads into a fan, 15 degrees per blade, and ripples at 0.268 rad/tick, each blade a twelfth of a period behind the last (:370-435).

The tail, the jaw and the two arms share one 0.77 rad/tick wave (an 8.2-tick period) but each moves hard only in the periods a per-entity random latch picks for it, re-rolled at every rising zero-crossing (:467-480): at rest the tail in 1 period of 15, the jaw in 1 of 15, each arm in 2 of 15; attacking the tail in 1 of 2, the jaw always, each arm in 2 of 4. The parts not picked sway, chomp or twitch faintly on a slow 0.22 rad/tick wave (:481-506). The jaw and claw waves are rectified (absolute values, :583, :615-643): they open and reach twice per period and never cross their rests.
The neck turns 0.35 of the look yaw and the head 0.75 of it, the head pieces, fangs and jaw riding the head by position (:436-463); the walk position plays no part.

The strike (Alien.doHurtTarget :170-194 with the boss's wither at AlienBoss.java:76-83) is rolled by the Alien's customServerAiStep (Alien.java:229-236), and the summon (AlienBoss.java:86-117) fires on a 200-tick cooldown — nothing in the code fires an animation for either.

locked_bones_note: The design's section 6 ModelAlien row (geckolib_migration_design.md:443): 'head [0.9,0.75] @1; torso [1.05,1.4] @0.5; stomach [0.9,0.9] @0.5; arml1/armr1 and lower arms [0.35,0.8] @0.5; thigh/shin pairs [0.4,1.1] @0.5; tail1/tail3/tail5 [0.3,0.5] @0.25'. head, torso, stomach, arml1, armr1, tail1, tail3 and tail5 resolve as written. 'lower arms' is not a bone name: taken as arml2 / armr2 (the forearms, ModelAlien.createBodyLayer). 'thigh/shin pairs' is not a bone name: taken as lThigh / rThigh and BOTH shin pieces a side, lShin1 (upper) and lShin (lower), rShin1 and rShin — the rig splits the shin in two (the feet lFoot / rFoot are left visual). The same list as `alien`'s at the same sizes: 'Separate registry profiles with one server-fed FK pose'; 'Do not enlarge bone boxes merely because AlienBoss has a larger root box unless the rendered scale is also proven larger' — both registries are drawn by AlienRenderer at x1.1 (OreSpawnClient.java:49, :53), so the sizes stay the Alien's.
